SimpleWall.ghx.Purpose: Heat flow through a two-layer brick wall held at 20 degC on one face and -5 degC on the other.
SimpleWall.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - transient conjugate heat transfer, not validated for this wall. Cite: Kastner and Dogan (SimAUD 2020).
SimpleWall.ghx.Method: CHT Case solves conduction in two 0.15 m CHT Solid blocks of CHT Material Brick for 10000 s; unassigned faces stay adiabatic.
SimpleWall.ghx.Result: Wall temperature T probed on a Brep Grid and drawn by Scalar Field Viewer; Live Residuals tracks convergence.
SimpleWall.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > Fully-coupled multi-region CFD / HAM / RAD / VEG (urbanMicroclimateFoam). Runtime: minutes.
SimpleWall.ghx.Edit: Wall blocks, materials, boundary temperatures and simulated time.

Breathing_Manikin.ghx.Purpose: Where exhaled CO2 goes around a breathing person in a small room.
Breathing_Manikin.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - transient CFD around a simplified manikin, not validated.
Breathing_Manikin.ghx.Method: Indoor Species Case solves CO2 as mass (OpenFOAM multicomponentFluid): 12 breaths a minute at 40000 ppm for 10 s.
Breathing_Manikin.ghx.Result: CO2 traces 0.15 m ahead of the mouth and in the far corner; the near one swings from about 20000 ppm to ambient each breath.
Breathing_Manikin.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > Fully-coupled multi-region CFD / HAM / RAD / VEG (urbanMicroclimateFoam); multicomponentFluid ships only in the UMF image. Runtime: minutes.
Breathing_Manikin.ghx.Edit: Manikin position and facing, breathing rate, room size, vent position.

CO2_Occupancy.ghx.Purpose: CO2 in an occupied, mechanically ventilated room, by CFD and by a quick analytic estimate.
CO2_Occupancy.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - steady RANS with CO2 as a passive scalar; the analytic route uses Persily and de Jonge's per-person rate.
CO2_Occupancy.ghx.Method: Indoor Case: 6 x 4 x 3 m room, 1 m2 inlet at 0.5 m/s, outlet opposite, a CO2 Emitter zone, Age of Air on.
CO2_Occupancy.ghx.Result: CO2, age of air and velocity in Scalar and Wind Field Viewers; Occupant CO2 gives 0.0043 L/s per person.
CO2_Occupancy.ghx.Edit: Room, inlet, outlet, emitter zone and rate; lower Cell Size, since Indoor Case warns the emitter zone is thin.

Natural_Ventilation.ghx.Purpose: Air flow through a room ventilated by one window, driven by an outdoor wind estimate.
Natural_Ventilation.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - EN 1991-1-4 wind and Maas (1995) window exchange set the inflow of a steady RANS room solve.
Natural_Ventilation.ghx.Method: Facade Wind Pressure gives wind at the opening; Window Air Exchange sets the inlet speed of a 5 x 4 x 2.5 m room.
Natural_Ventilation.ghx.Result: Velocity vectors through the room from Probe and Wind Field Viewer.
Natural_Ventilation.ghx.Edit: Basic wind speed, terrain category, opening size and height, room geometry.

Thermal_Comfort.ghx.Purpose: Thermal stratification and occupant comfort in a heated, ventilated room.
Thermal_Comfort.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - steady buoyant RANS; comfort from the Gagge two-node model.
Thermal_Comfort.ghx.Method: 3000 W Heat Source switches Indoor Case to the buoyant solver; low 20 degC inlet, high outlet, wall bands at 40 and 10 degC.
Thermal_Comfort.ghx.Result: Temperature and velocity fields, warmer at the ceiling than the floor; Two-Node Comfort gives SET and PMV.
Thermal_Comfort.ghx.Edit: Heat load, inlet temperature and speed, wall temperatures; feed probed air and radiant temperatures to Two-Node Comfort.

Validation_Zhang_Chen_UFAD.ghx.Purpose: Check the indoor solver against measured underfloor air distribution in a test chamber.
Validation_Zhang_Chen_UFAD.ghx.Fidelity: Validated against measurements. Cite: Zhang and Chen, Atmospheric Environment 2006. Diffuser, occupant and luminaire positions are reconstructed.
Validation_Zhang_Chen_UFAD.ghx.Method: Steady buoyant RANS of a 4.91 x 4.31 x 2.44 m chamber: two floor diffusers at 0.70 m/s, ceiling extract, occupants, luminaires.
Validation_Zhang_Chen_UFAD.ghx.Result: Vertical temperature profile; expect roughly 1.1 to 1.7 K/m from floor to ceiling.
Validation_Zhang_Chen_UFAD.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > (U)RANS CFD (OpenFOAM). Runtime: about an hour.
Validation_Zhang_Chen_UFAD.ghx.Edit: Nothing for the comparison itself; Cell Size (0.10 m default) for a grid-sensitivity study.

ClimateCharts.ghx.Purpose: A climate overview of one site: temperature, humidity, sun path and wind rose from a single EPW.
ClimateCharts.ghx.Fidelity: Screening - plots the weather file as recorded; no simulation.
ClimateCharts.ghx.Method: Download Weather fetches the station's EPW; Monthly Climate Chart, Sun Path and Wind Compass draw from the same Weather object.
ClimateCharts.ghx.Result: Monthly minimum, mean and maximum temperature and humidity charts, a sun-path dome and a 16-sector wind rose.
ClimateCharts.ghx.Needs: Nothing to install; Download Weather needs internet. Runtime: seconds.
ClimateCharts.ghx.Edit: Station name panel (Istanbul by default); the size panel (100) scales every chart.

Solar_radiation.ghx.Purpose: Annual solar irradiation in kWh/m2 over a ground surface and its surrounding facades.
Solar_radiation.ghx.Fidelity: Screening - interactive beam, sky and ground-reflected estimate, not a Radiance simulation.
Solar_radiation.ghx.Method: Brep Grid Points samples surfaces at 1 m; Sky Exposure gives sky view; Solar Irradiation sums every daylight hour of an Istanbul year.
Solar_radiation.ghx.Result: Ground and context coloured on one legend range; Text Tag prints rounded ground values.
Solar_radiation.ghx.Needs: Nothing to install; runs inside Rhino. Runtime: seconds to minutes.
Solar_radiation.ghx.Edit: Ground Brep, the ten context Breps, weather station.

PALM_4U.ghx.Purpose: Pedestrian-level PET maps from a PALM-4U large-eddy simulation of a small site.
PALM_4U.ghx.Fidelity: Experimental - skeleton workflow for the PALM-4U plugin.
PALM_4U.ghx.Method: PALM Domain (64 x 64 x 48 cells, 2 m), buildings, trees, terrain and OSM land cover feed PALM Case; 2 h, 3 m/s westerly.
PALM_4U.ghx.Result: Time-averaged bio_pet field from PALM Results; PALM Progress follows the container run.
PALM_4U.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > Urban microclimate / LES / RANS (PALM-4U). Runtime: hours.
PALM_4U.ghx.Edit: Domain size and resolution, STL buildings and trees, terrain, wind, simulated time; toggle Fetch for land cover.

Surrogate_annual_thermal_comfort_analysi.Purpose: UTCI across a circular site for one hour or the whole year, without CFD.
Surrogate_annual_thermal_comfort_analysi.Fidelity: Screening - machine-learning wind (Yel 2.0); trees count as solid obstructions.
Surrogate_annual_thermal_comfort_analysi.Method: Wind Predictor for 8 directions, scaled to each Atlanta hour by VAF; MRT Surface, Sensors, View Factors and Solve feed UTCI (Simulation).
Surrogate_annual_thermal_comfort_analysi.Result: UTCI per sensor on a 4 m grid at 1.8 m, coloured by Thermal Comfort Legend; an Hourly/Annual list picks the hour.
Surrogate_annual_thermal_comfort_analysi.Needs: Nothing to install; ML Model downloads Yel 2.0 on first use. Runtime: minutes.
Surrogate_annual_thermal_comfort_analysi.Edit: Buildings, trees, ground, weather file, sensor grid spacing.

Surrogate_hourly_thermal_comfort_analysi.Purpose: UTCI at sensors on a circular patch for single hours, with machine-learning wind.
Surrogate_hourly_thermal_comfort_analysi.Fidelity: Screening - machine-learning wind (Yel 2.0); buildings only, no trees.
Surrogate_hourly_thermal_comfort_analysi.Method: Wind Predictor at 7 m/s for 8 directions, VAF per Atlanta hour; MRT View Factors (192 sky patches, Fast) and MRT Solve feed UTCI (Simulation).
Surrogate_hourly_thermal_comfort_analysi.Result: UTCI per sensor; Deconstruct UTCI reduces it to statistics.
Surrogate_hourly_thermal_comfort_analysi.Needs: Nothing to install; ML Model downloads Yel 2.0 on first use. Runtime: minutes.
Surrogate_hourly_thermal_comfort_analysi.Edit: Context Brep, sensor patch, weather file; add trees to model their shade.

UMF_UTCI_sloped_terrain.ghx.Purpose: UTCI at 1.8 m for one summer hour in Istanbul over sloped terrain, with air, surfaces and trees coupled.
UMF_UTCI_sloped_terrain.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - coupled urbanMicroclimateFoam, not validated for this site. Cite: Kubilay et al., urbanMicroclimateFoam.
UMF_UTCI_sloped_terrain.ghx.Method: Outdoor+ Case couples Terrain, Building and Vegetation Regions; ABL wind from the EPW at 20 July 09:00; MRT from probed surface temperatures.
UMF_UTCI_sloped_terrain.ghx.Result: UTCI on a 1 m sensor grid; probed air temperature, velocity, humidity and surface temperatures.
UMF_UTCI_sloped_terrain.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > Fully-coupled multi-region CFD / HAM / RAD / VEG (urbanMicroclimateFoam); saved with BlueCFD. Runtime: hours.
UMF_UTCI_sloped_terrain.ghx.Edit: Terrain, building and vegetation meshes; weather file and Calendar hour.

UMF_UTCI_water_surface.ghx.Purpose: How an evaporating water surface changes UTCI on a flat Istanbul site on 20 May at 16:00.
UMF_UTCI_water_surface.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - coupled urbanMicroclimateFoam with the simpleWater model. Cite: Kubilay et al., urbanMicroclimateFoam.
UMF_UTCI_water_surface.ghx.Method: Water Surface (0.5 m mixed depth) exchanges heat and moisture inside Outdoor+ Case beside Terrain, Building and Vegetation Regions.
UMF_UTCI_water_surface.ghx.Result: UTCI per sensor; probed air and surface temperatures, velocity and humidity.
UMF_UTCI_water_surface.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > Fully-coupled multi-region CFD / HAM / RAD / VEG (urbanMicroclimateFoam) on BlueCFD only; the container image lacks simpleWater. Runtime: hours.
UMF_UTCI_water_surface.ghx.Edit: Water outline and depth, buildings, vegetation, date and hour.

ViewShed.ghx.Purpose: How open the view is from points on a surface, and how much of a target each point can see.
ViewShed.ghx.Fidelity: Screening - geometric ray casting; a plan-view measure, not a daylight metric.
ViewShed.ghx.Method: Viewshed casts a 26 degree half-angle cone out to 48 m from each mesh vertex; View Target casts rays to the target past shared context.
ViewShed.ghx.Result: Values from 0 to 1, with colours, per observer point.
ViewShed.ghx.Needs: Nothing to install; runs inside Rhino. Runtime: seconds to minutes.
ViewShed.ghx.Edit: Context, observer surfaces and target; wire normals to aim the cones.

WRF.ghx.Purpose: Site weather for Atlanta from a regional WRF run driven by GFS forecasts.
WRF.ghx.Fidelity: Experimental - mesoscale workflow; 3 km nest on low-resolution geography.
WRF.ghx.Method: WRF Met Data fetches 0.25 degree GFS from NOMADS; 3 km Lambert nest inside a 9 km parent; WPS and WRF run in a container.
WRF.ghx.Result: 2 m temperature and 10 m wind viewers; WRF Weather and WRF ABL derive CFD weather and inflow.
WRF.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > Mesoscale weather / Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF). Runtime: hours.
WRF.ghx.Edit: Dates (NOMADS keeps about ten days), domain centre and size.

Stormwater.ghx.Purpose: Where water can pond on a graded site, and which way it runs.
Stormwater.ghx.Fidelity: Experimental - surface routing only, no pipes; the IDF coefficients are placeholders.
Stormwater.ghx.Method: Stormwater Grid rasterises the terrain at 1 m; Fast mode computes terrain analytics, Full mode solves shallow-water depths.
Stormwater.ghx.Result: A depression-capacity mesh and runoff flowlines up to 240 m, coloured by contributing area.
Stormwater.ghx.Needs: Nothing to install; runs inside Rhino. Runtime: seconds to minutes, Full mode the slower.
Stormwater.ghx.Edit: Terrain surface; real IDF coefficients a, b, c in Design Storm; connect Land Cover Runoff.

Sunpath.ghx.Purpose: A sun path diagram for a city, as editable Rhino curves.
Sunpath.ghx.Fidelity: Screening - solar geometry only, no weather or obstructions.
Sunpath.ghx.Method: Sun Path reads latitude, longitude and time zone from the station's EPW and draws daily arcs and hourly analemmas.
Sunpath.ghx.Result: Arcs for 21 June, 20 March and 21 December, hourly analemmas, a horizon circle and a text report at the origin.
Sunpath.ghx.Needs: Nothing to install; Download Weather needs internet. Runtime: seconds.
Sunpath.ghx.Edit: Station panel, Radius, North and Arc Days; wire sun vectors to plot positions.

WeatherMorphing.ghx.Purpose: Future-climate weather files morphed from a present-day Atlanta EPW, set beside the baseline.
WeatherMorphing.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - statistical morphing by the Future Weather Generator, not a climate simulation.
WeatherMorphing.ghx.Method: Morph Weather runs the generator jar with Morph Settings; two Deconstruct Weather components expose the baseline and a morphed file.
WeatherMorphing.ghx.Result: Morphed EPW files plus side-by-side temperature, humidity, wind and solar series.
WeatherMorphing.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > Morph weather (Future Weather Generator): Java 17+ and the jar, not shipped. Runtime: minutes to hours.
WeatherMorphing.ghx.Edit: Station, the jar File Path, Morph Settings; turn Run on.

WindRose.ghx.Purpose: An annual wind rose for a city in the Rhino viewport.
WindRose.ghx.Fidelity: Screening - bins the weather file as recorded; no simulation.
WindRose.ghx.Method: Wind Compass bins every hour into 16 sectors stacked by speed; hours below 0.5 m/s count as calm.
WindRose.ghx.Result: Petals sized by frequency and coloured by wind-speed band; the banner reports the hours plotted.
WindRose.ghx.Needs: Nothing to install; Download Weather needs internet. Runtime: seconds.
WindRose.ghx.Edit: Station panel, Radius, Base Point; insert a Weather component before Wind Compass, which rejects the file path.

FluidX3D.ghx.Purpose: Wind around buildings on the GPU, watched live in the viewport.
FluidX3D.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - transient lattice-Boltzmann CFD, not validated for this site; FluidX3D's licence excludes commercial use.
FluidX3D.ghx.Method: LBM Case with FluidX3D Run Settings: 2 m grid, 720 s simulated, ABL inflow of 5 m/s at 10 m.
FluidX3D.ghx.Result: FluidX3D Live View colours a probe mesh while it runs; Scalar and Vector Field Viewers show probed values.
FluidX3D.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > LBM CFD (FluidX3D), built locally; needs a GPU. Runtime: minutes.
FluidX3D.ghx.Edit: Geometry, grid spacing, simulated time, inflow.

OpenLB.ghx.Purpose: Time-averaged pedestrian wind around buildings from lattice-Boltzmann LES.
OpenLB.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - OpenLB D3Q19 with Smagorinsky LES, not validated for this site.
OpenLB.ghx.Method: LBM Case with LBM Run Settings: 6 m grid, GPU on, inflow jitter on; runtime tries Podman, then Docker, then native.
OpenLB.ghx.Result: The time-averaged pedestrian-level wind field in a Vector Field Viewer beside the domain wireframe.
OpenLB.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > LBM CFD (OpenLB); the GPU build needs NVIDIA. Runtime: minutes to hours.
OpenLB.ghx.Edit: Geometry; Grid Spacing (halving it costs 8x the memory and about 16x the time).

ML_CreateDataset.ghx.Purpose: Turn CFD wind solutions into labelled CSV rows for training wind surrogates.
ML_CreateDataset.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - steady RANS (realizable k-epsilon, SIMPLE) labels; a dataset is only as good as its CFD.
ML_CreateDataset.ghx.Method: Outdoor Case solves 8 directions on a Cylinder Domain; Probe samples U on a 2 m grid at 1.8 m; Dataset Curator writes features.
ML_CreateDataset.ghx.Result: One CSV per direction (SDF, building height, direction) plus a merge script; Dataset Reader previews mag_U.
ML_CreateDataset.ghx.Edit: Buildings and terrain (radius above 500 m); probe k as well, which the merge needs.

ML_Inference.ghx.Purpose: Pedestrian-height wind maps around buildings from a trained model instead of CFD.
ML_Inference.ghx.Fidelity: Screening, not CFD - Yel 2.0 model. Cite: Karadag and Kastner (Routledge, in press).
ML_Inference.ghx.Method: Wind Predictor runs Yel 2.0 on a 2 m grid 1.8 m above the terrain for one compass direction at 5 m/s.
ML_Inference.ghx.Result: A jet-coloured velocity mesh with a 0 to 5 m/s legend and a Wind Compass.
ML_Inference.ghx.Needs: Nothing to install; ML Model downloads Yel 2.0 on first use. Runtime: seconds to minutes.
ML_Inference.ghx.Edit: One of three sample building sets, or your Breps centred on the terrain; wind direction.

ML_Inference_Comfort.ghx.Purpose: Year-round pedestrian wind comfort classes around buildings, without running CFD.
ML_Inference_Comfort.ghx.Fidelity: Screening, not CFD - confirm decisions with a Wind Study. Cite: Karadag and Kastner (Routledge, in press).
ML_Inference_Comfort.ghx.Method: Yel 2.0 wind for 16 directions on a 2 m grid; Weibull fit per point against Istanbul weather; Lawson General criteria.
ML_Inference_Comfort.ghx.Result: A comfort-class mesh and legend; roofs are classified where the model supplies roof speeds.
ML_Inference_Comfort.ghx.Needs: Nothing to install; ML Model downloads Yel 2.0 on first use. Runtime: minutes.
ML_Inference_Comfort.ghx.Edit: Buildings (three samples included), weather station, comfort metric (Lawson, Davenport or NEN 8100).

ML_Inference_moving_circle.ghx.Purpose: Explore wind across a large context by dragging a 450 m analysis circle over it.
ML_Inference_moving_circle.ghx.Method: Settle Data waits for the slider to be released, then Wind Predictor reruns on a 2 m grid 1.8 m above the circle.
ML_Inference_moving_circle.ghx.Result: A jet velocity mesh with a 0 to 5 m/s legend and a Wind Compass sized to the circle.
ML_Inference_moving_circle.ghx.Needs: Nothing to install; ML Model downloads Yel 2.0 on first use. Runtime: seconds to minutes.
ML_Inference_moving_circle.ghx.Edit: Context, circle radius, wind direction (Value List, southeast by default).

MRT_Mixed.ghx.Purpose: Annual mean radiant temperature at ground and building sensors, on the fast path.
MRT_Mixed.ghx.Fidelity: Screening - surfaces at air temperature; no Radiance or EnergyPlus.
MRT_Mixed.ghx.Method: MRT Surface tags ground and 22 context Breps; MRT Sensors on 2 m grids; MRT View Factors and MRT Solve with Atlanta weather.
MRT_Mixed.ghx.Result: A coloured MRT mesh, Text Tag values, and one sensor's sky dome in Fisheye View.
MRT_Mixed.ghx.Needs: Nothing to install; runs inside Rhino. Runtime: minutes.
MRT_Mixed.ghx.Edit: Ground and context Breps, weather station; press the two Buttons to run.

MRT_Radiance.ghx.Purpose: Annual mean radiant temperature at ground sensors, with interreflected sun and computed surface temperatures.
MRT_Radiance.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - Radiance shortwave plus EnergyPlus surface temperatures, not validated for this site.
MRT_Radiance.ghx.Method: One MRT component runs Radiance (Standard quality) and EnergyPlus; Brep Grid Points meshes ground and context at 2 m.
MRT_Radiance.ghx.Result: Annual mean MRT per probe, shown by Gradient and Text Tag.
MRT_Radiance.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > Comfort study (Radiance / EnergyPlus). Runtime: hours.
MRT_Radiance.ghx.Edit: Ground and context Breps, the EPW URL; turn Run on.

Solar_Access.ghx.Purpose: Sun hours and BRE amenity overshadowing on a small ground plane beside a tall box.
Solar_Access.ghx.Fidelity: Screening - geometric ray casting, direct beam only.
Solar_Access.ghx.Method: Facade Grid lays 1 m cells; Sun Hours covers 1 July for Sun Stats and Sunlight Compliance; Shadow and Solar Irradiation cover the year.
Solar_Access.ghx.Result: Per-cell sun hours, BRE pass or fail, annual shadow and irradiation.
Solar_Access.ghx.Needs: Nothing to install; runs inside Rhino. Runtime: seconds.
Solar_Access.ghx.Edit: The Box 2Pt context, the ground plane, the weather station (Ithaca by default).

Sun_Hours.ghx.Purpose: Annual direct-sun hours across a site and its context.
Sun_Hours.ghx.Fidelity: Screening - geometric direct beam only; no diffuse or reflected light, not Radiance.
Sun_Hours.ghx.Method: Hourly ray casting toward the sun for every daylight hour of an Atlanta year; tree crowns pass 20 percent of the beam.
Sun_Hours.ghx.Result: Points and a mesh coloured by annual sun hours.
Sun_Hours.ghx.Needs: Nothing to install; runs inside Rhino. Runtime: seconds to minutes, growing with point count.
Sun_Hours.ghx.Edit: Context meshes, ground surface, canopy crowns, weather station.

SurfaceTemps_EnergyPlus.ghx.Purpose: Surface temperatures for MRT from EnergyPlus, staged so the costly view factors are solved once.
SurfaceTemps_EnergyPlus.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - EnergyPlus surface heat balance, not validated for this block.
SurfaceTemps_EnergyPlus.ghx.Method: MRT View Factors, then SurfaceTemp (EnergyPlus), then MRT Solve, for a 10 x 10 x 15 m block with Ithaca weather.
SurfaceTemps_EnergyPlus.ghx.Result: Surface temperatures and MRT at 5 m facade sensors offset 1.1 m.
SurfaceTemps_EnergyPlus.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > Comfort study (Radiance / EnergyPlus). Runtime: minutes to hours.
SurfaceTemps_EnergyPlus.ghx.Edit: Working Directory (CHANGE-ME), block and ground, station; click the three Run toggles in order.

SurfaceTemps_FFT.ghx.Purpose: Outdoor surface temperatures for a full year, without a thermal mesh or warm-up.
SurfaceTemps_FFT.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - frequency-domain admittance method. Cite: Beckett, Owens and Acred.
SurfaceTemps_FFT.ghx.Method: SurfaceTemp solves grass_ground and brick_wall constructions against Istanbul weather, with sky view from Sky Exposure and 22 degC indoors.
SurfaceTemps_FFT.ghx.Result: Mean, Min and Max of each point's 8760-hour series, coloured with rounded Text Tag labels.
SurfaceTemps_FFT.ghx.Needs: Nothing to install; runs inside Rhino. Runtime: seconds to minutes.
SurfaceTemps_FFT.ghx.Edit: Ground and context Breps, weather station, materials.

ABL_Verification.ghx.Purpose: Does the boundary layer imposed at the inlet survive to the buildings?
ABL_Verification.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - a partial ASCE/SEI CWE Prestandard approach-flow check, run in the real domain rather than an empty one.
ABL_Verification.ghx.Method: Steady RANS (realizable k-epsilon, 400 iterations) in a Box Domain; ABL of 5 m/s at 10 m, z0 1 m.
ABL_Verification.ghx.Result: U on two vertical rakes at x = 0 and x = 40 m, from 2.5 to 77.5 m, plotted together; some decay is expected.
ABL_Verification.ghx.Edit: ABL speed and z0, domain, mesh settings, rake positions.

BoxDomain.ghx.Purpose: Wind around buildings and dense tree canopy in a rectangular domain.
BoxDomain.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - steady RANS (realizable k-epsilon, SIMPLE), not validated for this site.
BoxDomain.ghx.Method: Atmospheric Boundary Layer inflow; Outdoor Case with Box Domain, Mesh Settings and Run Settings on 12 CPUs, Containerized engine.
BoxDomain.ghx.Result: U at probe points as arrows with Flex Legend, Streamlines, a CSV for viz.eddy3d.com, and residual and meshing monitors.
BoxDomain.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > (U)RANS CFD (OpenFOAM). Runtime: about an hour.

CylinderDomain.ghx.Purpose: Pedestrian-level wind around an Atlanta site for every prevailing wind direction, solved on one mesh.
CylinderDomain.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - steady RANS, not validated for this site. Cite: Kastner and Dogan (2020), cylindrical mesh.
CylinderDomain.ghx.Method: Steady RANS in OpenFOAM on a cylindrical mesh; Wind Rose Cluster reduces the EPW to up to 8 directions and speeds.
CylinderDomain.ghx.Result: Velocity U probed 1.5 m above terrain, one direction per slider step.
CylinderDomain.ghx.Edit: Station, site coordinates, buildings, tree zones; toggle Fetch for land cover and terrain.

Facade_Pressure.ghx.Purpose: Wind pressure coefficients on facades for building energy models, over eight wind directions.
Facade_Pressure.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - steady RANS mean Cp, not validated for this building.
Facade_Pressure.ghx.Method: Outdoor Case with a Cylinder Domain, directions 0 to 315 degrees in 45 degree steps, Cp output on in Run Settings.
Facade_Pressure.ghx.Result: Cp at 1 m facade points (set Probe Field to Cp); Airflow Network Cp writes an EnergyPlus .idf snippet.
Facade_Pressure.ghx.Edit: The two 40 x 20 x 20 m blocks: replace them with your building.

Pollutant_Canyon.ghx.Purpose: Where a street-level emission goes, and how much reaches pedestrians.
Pollutant_Canyon.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - steady RANS with a passive tracer, not validated for this canyon.
Pollutant_Canyon.ghx.Method: Two 40 x 20 x 20 m blocks form a canyon; Pollutant Source releases 0.01 kg/s of exhaust from a volume inside it.
Pollutant_Canyon.ghx.Result: Tracer concentration in kg/m3 at three points 2 m above ground along the canyon centreline.
Pollutant_Canyon.ghx.Edit: Blocks, source volume and rate, probe points; turn the toggles on.

UMF_UTCI.ghx.Purpose: UTCI at 1.8 m for one hour in Istanbul from a fully coupled microclimate simulation.
UMF_UTCI.ghx.Fidelity: Engineering - coupled urbanMicroclimateFoam, not validated for this site. Cite: Kubilay et al., urbanMicroclimateFoam.
UMF_UTCI.ghx.Method: Air, Building, Vegetation and Terrain regions with Timing Parameters from the EPW at a Calendar hour; MRT View Factors and MRT Solve.
UMF_UTCI.ghx.Result: Mean UTCI per sensor with a legend; probed air temperature, wind, humidity, surface and tree temperatures.
UMF_UTCI.ghx.Needs: Eddy3D Setup > Fully-coupled multi-region CFD / HAM / RAD / VEG (urbanMicroclimateFoam), on BlueCFD, WSL or container. Runtime: hours.
UMF_UTCI.ghx.Edit: Embedded building, tree and terrain meshes; weather file and Calendar hour.
